title: Monthly water area of the King Fahd Dam reservoir, Bisha, from Sentinel-2: January 2017 to November 2026

headline.label: median reservoir water area over 107 usable dates

service.name: Surface Water, Reservoir and Flood Extent Mapping from Imagery

data: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance, tile 38QKG, bands B03, B08, B11 and the SCL layer at 20 m.
method: For each month: the least cloudy complete scene (tile cloud under 20%), reading only a 12 × 15.5 km window around the lake.
Masked SCL classes no data, defective, cloud shadow, cloud and cirrus.
Water = NDWI (B03 and B08) above 0, or B11 reflectance below 0.05.
Reservoir zone: the largest connected area that is water in at least 5% of clear observations, grown by 100 m (1,485 ha).
limits: The results were not compared with finer imagery or gauge readings, so there is no accuracy figure. Automatic detection fails on some dates (sun glint, clipped atmospheric correction), and the quality flag catches sharp drops only. At 20 m, narrow arms and shores are measured roughly.
